extra.reason: Scaffold complete: uv/hatchling src layout, ruff+mypy --strict gate green, pytest+Hypothesis tier profiles, CI matrix incl. pypy3.11, just recipes, spec-check wired.

12 error classes + CordisError base in src/cordis/errors.py, all exported from the package root. Each subclasses the builtin a caller already catches (ServiceNotFoundError is an AttributeError, InvalidEffectError a TypeError, ...). Mount-site attribution via add_note in mount_attribution(); type/traceback preservation and note ordering property-tested, and both failure_values verified by deliberate mutation.

tests/support/ built: ResourceLedger (conservation oracle, strict on double/orphan release, reverse-order assertion), VirtualClock (deterministic logical time, wakes each sleeper at its own deadline, exposes pending timers as the leak witness), TransitionRecorder (fiber transition table transcribed from SEM-002/003, rejects illegal edges at the source), specs.py models (TreeSpec inheritance, DagSpec acyclic-by-rank, diff_entries loader model, EffectSpec shapes) and strategies.py. 25 self-tests. Tier profiles wired to pytest markers; 'just discards' added. NOTE: the 10%-discard acceptance criterion was replaced -- see close notes in the test docstring: Hypothesis counts engine overruns as 'invalid', so filter-free control strategies also report 10-20%. Enforcement is now an AST check banning .filter/assume in the generator library without a stated reason (verified by mutation) plus Hypothesis's own filter_too_much health check, left on in every profile.

EffectScope landed: src/cordis/effect.py + tests/test_effect_scope.py (all 8 PROP-EFFECT cards + SEM-008 dedup). Widened SEM-001 from 'generator' to '(sync or async) iterable of disposers' with a deviation block after PROP-EFFECT-001 rejected a plain list. Gate green: ruff, ruff format, mypy strict (15 files), 65 tests.

Context tree landed: src/cordis/context.py + tests/test_context_tree.py. All 6 property cards passing (PROP-CTX-006 added to close the SEM-005 coverage gap), each verified by deliberately introducing its failure_value. PROP-CTX-003 amended: mutation testing showed the metamorphic comparison alone accepts a symmetric falsy-dropping merge, so the card now also requires agreement with a plain dict merge. Both open questions resolved/deferred in the record. Gate green: ruff, format, mypy strict (17 files), 73 tests, spec-check 117 cards / 8 warnings.

Service registry landed: src/cordis/registry.py + tests/test_registry.py. All 6 property cards passing plus a realm-inheritance test for SEM-002; every card verified by deliberately introducing its failure_value. Two cards amended: PROP-REG-001 and PROP-REG-006 stated failure values that are unreachable through the public surface (EffectHandle idempotence absorbs the second dispose before the registry sees it), so both were restated around reachable defects in the same class and the reasoning recorded in the record's notes. provide() returns the EffectHandle (disposer + awaitable readiness) rather than a bare Disposer; realms are scoped metadata under a dunder key rather than a Context field. Service.__aenter__ deferred to plugin-mounting, recorded in open_questions. Gate green: ruff, format, mypy strict (19 files), 80 tests.

Event bus implemented: src/cordis/events.py + tests/test_events.py. 10 property cards passing (PROP-EVENT-001..010), each verified by deliberate mutation (12 mutations, 12 caught). Spec record advanced to implemented; SEM-011 added for async listeners on bail events; waterfall signature deviation and the emit concurrency reading recorded. ruff, ruff format, mypy --strict clean; 90 tests pass.

Plugin mounting implemented: src/cordis/plugin.py + src/cordis/fiber.py (capability 04's FiberState enum landed early, one-way dependency plugin->fiber) + tests/test_plugin_mounting.py. 9 property cards passing (PROP-PLUGIN-001..008), each verified by deliberate mutation: 13 mutations, 13 caught. Two spec amendments came out of that run: PROP-PLUGIN-001 restated (its stated failure value was a defect in user code, unfalsifiable before declared injections land with capability 05 — original wording moves to that capability), and new SEM-008/PROP-PLUGIN-008 after probing showed a just-failed instance accepted mounts until its rollback was scheduled. SEM-001 widened to reject generator bodies, which previously mounted ACTIVE having run nothing. python_design rewritten to the real surface with a new deviations list; open questions deferred with reasons. ruff, ruff format, mypy --strict clean; 99 tests pass; spec-check 20 capabilities / 141 rules / 119 cards, no new coverage warnings.

Fiber lifecycle implemented: 7 property cards passing (PROP-FIBER-001..007), each mutation-verified against its own failure_value; spec advanced to implemented with SEM-009 (scheduling without a running loop) added under the change protocol; both open questions resolved. Three real defects found and fixed: label reuse after disposal, listener faults aborting a transition, and asyncio.ensure_future scheduling onto a loop nobody runs.

Dependency injection implemented: cordis.inject (declarations, three spellings, one reader), Fiber epoch + provides, FiberRuntime enrol/report/audit cycle detection. PROP-INJECT-001..007 passing, each mutation-verified (10 mutants, all caught). Spec advanced to implemented with 3 new SEM rules and 5 deviations.

Capability 07 implemented: cordis.config (ConfigIssue/ConfigResult/ConfigSchema protocol, config_schema, schema_of, resolve_config, stdlib from_dataclass adapter) plus the mount seam in PluginHandle. All 7 property cards passing with test_ids; each verified by deliberate mutation (9 mutants, all caught). Spec advanced to implemented with 3 new deviations, 2 idioms, 2 typing notes, 1 concurrency note; open question on the built-in schema resolved.

service isolation implemented: cordis.realm (isolate/isolated_realm/isolated_names), registry realm_key/realm_for/provide(ctx=), plugin(isolate=); PROP-ISO-001..005 passing, 5/5 mutants caught; spec 08 status implemented, open question resolved

service interception implemented: cordis.intercept (intercept/intercept_all/interceptions/merge_interceptions/effective_config), registry service_name+token_label consolidation, plugin(intercept=); PROP-INTC-001..004 passing, 8/8 mutants caught; spec 09 implemented, both open questions resolved

event filtering implemented: cordis.filter (FILTER_KEY, Filter, with_filter, filter_of), events.EventBus admission (_admitted/_ask, ctx=/global_= on on(), carrier-aware private dispatchers) and EventBus.through -> BoundBus; PROP-FILTER-001..004 passing, 7/7 mutants caught; spec 10 implemented, SEM-002 strengthened to per-filter, open question resolved (replacing, not composing)

logging implemented: cordis.logging (Level, Record, Exporter, ExportFailure, LoggerService, Logger, logger(ctx,name)) + cordis.exporters (Console, Stdlib) + plugin FIBER_KEY/fiber_of; PROP-LOG-001..006 passing, 10/10 mutants caught; spec 12 implemented, SEM-001 reworded, PROP-LOG-005 failure value restated, 4 deviations recorded

scheduling implemented: cordis.timer (Clock, SystemClock, clock_of, TimerFailure, spawn, timeout, interval/Schedule, throttle, debounce); PROP-TIMER-001..005 passing across 6 tests, 13/13 mutants caught; spec 13 implemented, 2 deviations added (grid starts when the loop does; non-positive period rejected), open question resolved start-based-with-skipping

Diagnostics implemented: src/cordis/diagnostics.py (inspect/pending/walk/render_tree, FiberSnapshot/Blockage/PendingReport) plus two kernel changes recorded as deviations (Fiber.uid serial identity, EffectScope.tree(skip=) pruning the nursery). 13 tests in tests/test_diagnostics.py; PROP-DIAG-001..005 passing; 16/16 mutants caught; just check and just spec-check clean.

Scoped registration implemented: src/cordis/scope.py (Scope, create_scope, subject_of, scope_target, admits, ScopedRegistry). Visibility down / admission up are one relation (Scope.covers) used in both roles. 13 tests in tests/test_scope.py; PROP-SCOPE-001..006 passing (006 added to cover SEM-005/SEM-007); 12/12 mutants caught; just check and just spec-check clean.

capability seam implemented: cordis.seam (Definition/Registry/resolve_spec), 13 tests in tests/test_seam.py covering PROP-SEAM-001..005, 17/17 mutants caught, record updated to implemented with 5 deviations and the import-direction open question resolved
loader implemented: 9 property cards passing, 25/25 mutants caught

Capability 17 (hot reload) closed: spec -> tests -> implementation -> mutation. src/cordis/hmr.py (import graph via ast, escalation/refusal, coalesced reloads, config files through the loader's own reconcile); tests/test_hmr.py covers PROP-HMR-001..006 against real generated modules under a temporary root; 16/16 mutants caught; kernel widenings PluginHandle.form and LoaderService.remount(paths, between=...) recorded as reciprocal deviations in records 03 and 14.
config expressions: spec, cordis.expr, loader/plugin integration, 26 tests, 20/20 mutations caught
config layering: spec amended, cordis.layering, 20 tests, 20/20 mutations caught

Public surface curated and held by tests: test_public_api.py (189 exports, every one traced to a capability record's surface; module __all__ names either exported or held back with a reason), a runnable README quickstart executed by test_readme.py, and generated docs/reference.md with just docs / just docs-check wired into just ci.

examples/notes: Definition (Store) + two providers (MemoryStore, FileStore) + two consumers + an isolating group + a patch layer, booting from cordis.yml through an 8-line launcher. 'python -m examples.notes.app' swaps the provider at runtime with no consumer edits; --dump-config prints the layered resolution with per-field provenance. tests/test_example.py asserts the scenario, the isolation, the provenance and the seam's import graph; 8/8 mutations caught. Also added Definition.of(ctx) (capability 19), because ctx.require(SomeDefinition) cannot type-check under --strict.

Packaging done and verified against the built artefact, not just the source tree. pyproject reads the version from cordis.__version__ (hatch), sdist carries spec/tests/examples/docs, wheel is cordis_python-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl with py.typed; twine check PASSED. Installed that wheel into fresh venvs: 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 and pypy3.11 all import and mount (0.1.0, 189 exports).

Two portability defects surfaced only by doing that, both fixed spec-first and mutation-verified (3/3 caught):
- Python 3.11 rejects a mappingproxy dataclass default as mutable, so Record.extra, Patch.fields and Resolution.provenance made 'import cordis' raise ValueError on the minimum interpreter. Now field(default_factory=...) returning the shared proxy; recorded in 12-logging and 16-config-layering; tests/test_public_api.py now fails on any interpreter if the plain spelling comes back.
- normalise() read type(target).__weakrefoffset__, a CPython-only attribute, so every mount on PyPy raised AttributeError (108 failures). Cacheability is now asked of the WeakKeyDictionary itself, which also fixes unhashable targets on CPython. Recorded in 03-plugin-mounting; new test in test_plugin_mounting.py. PyPy 3.11 now runs 797 passed.

Also shipped: CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog + the rule that a normative spec rule is public contract), release.yml (tag -> release-tier gates -> build -> PyPI trusted publishing, no token in the repo), a package job in ci.yml. just ci green: 20 capabilities / 145 rules / 126 cards, ruff, mypy --strict on 65 files, docs current, 797 tests.

Publication itself is cordis-python-p3o: it needs the user's go-ahead.

All four acceptance criteria met.

- 20/20 capability records read status: implemented; 126/126 property cards read status: passing, each with a real test_id that check_spec resolves.
- mypy --strict clean on 65 files, ruff (24 rule sets) and ruff format clean, zero runtime dependencies and no C extensions: the wheel is py3-none-any and the full suite runs 797 passed on CPython 3.11/3.12/3.13 and on PyPy 3.11.
- examples/notes boots from cordis.yml through an 8-line launcher and swaps MemoryStore for FileStore at runtime with no consumer edits; tests/test_example.py asserts the scenario, the isolation, the layered provenance and the seam's import graph.

Built on the way: spec/ (versioned JSON Schema + 20 records, 145 normative rules), docs/reference.md generated from the docstrings and the catalog with a staleness gate in CI, a README whose quickstart is executed by tests/test_readme.py, CHANGELOG.md, ci.yml (spec, gates, package, 4-interpreter matrix with a persisted Hypothesis database) and release.yml (tag -> release-tier gates -> PyPI trusted publishing).

Publication is cordis-python-p3o and awaits the user's go-ahead.
